data.body:
Re-review BLOCKed with 6 findings. All 6 verified against the tree and all 6 were correct; fixed:

1-4 (one defect, reported four times) — the Testing pytest command still named `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_inbound_differ_field_contract.py` while step 5 of the same plan declares that directory nonexistent. The package move already landed (`src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/` -> `src/rebar/reconciler`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` -> `tests/unit/reconciler/`). Collection would have failed, so the plan's own verification was a broken oracle. Corrected; step 5's deliberate corrective prose (the one remaining `rebar_reconciler` mention) is left alone.

5 — `infra/gerrit/feature-branch-e2e-scenarios.sh:348` does not exist: the file is 344 lines and the `docs/88ab-feature-branch-evidence.md AC5` comment is at :339. Corrected, with the file length recorded so the next drift is detectable.

6 — substantive, and the only one that was not a citation error. `docs/dco-rollout-evidence.md:5-7` asserts its own story's AC requires the evidence 'captured in-repo, not only in the ticket tracker'. The plan retired that constraint for the serena sample by recorded operator decision but said nothing for DCO, so deleting it would silently defeat a stated AC. Step 1 now extends the same recorded decision to DCO and requires the relocation comment to say so.

Both DROPPED findings were also verified and were also correct: AGENTS.md cites the guides at :225/:443 (not :215,:428) and the basenames are at `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/registry.py:615-616` (not :665-666). That is 5 of 5 `veto:cited-reference-inaccurate` drops verified wrong across three tickets — appended to bug 1d00-91dd-23a2-4933.

The AGENTS.md cites are now anchored to a grep rather than a bare line number, because change 3179 (story 6f24, in review now) inserts ~10 lines at AGENTS.md:387 and shifts :443 to :453.
